description: Angular component for rendering a tree view with nested nodes, handling user interactions, and managing collapsed/expanded state.

classes.name: TreeComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying hierarchical tree structure with interactive nodes.

methods.name: childTrackById
methods.description: Provides a unique identifier for child nodes for Angular's trackBy.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, setting default collapsed state.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, emitting selection if node is highlighted.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Removes event listeners on component destruction.

methods.name: onNodeClick
methods.description: Handles click events on nodes, toggling collapse or updating highlight.

methods.name: nodeOffsetStyle
methods.description: Calculates CSS styles for node indentation based on depth.

methods.name: updateHighlightedItems
methods.description: Emits event to update highlighted node ID.

methods.name: isPinned
methods.description: Checks if current node is pinned.

methods.name: propagateNewHighlightedItem
methods.description: Emits event for new highlighted item ID.

methods.name: propagateNewPinnedItem
methods.description: Emits event for new pinned item.

methods.name: propagateNewSelectedTree
methods.description: Emits event for new selected tree node.

methods.name: isClickable
methods.description: Determines if node is clickable.

methods.name: toggleTree
methods.description: Toggles node collapsed/expanded state.

methods.name: expandTree
methods.description: Expands node.

methods.name: isCollapsed
methods.description: Checks if node is collapsed, considering global or local state.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns child nodes.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Determines if node has children to display.

methods.name: setCollapseValue
methods.description: Sets collapse state, updating store if global state is used.

methods.name: nodeMouseDownEventListener
methods.description: Handles mousedown event on node.

methods.name: nodeMouseEnterEventListener
methods.description: Handles mouse enter event on node.

methods.name: nodeMouseLeaveEventListener
methods.description: Handles mouse leave event on node.
